jobs_results.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs_results.description: Job Title Senior QA Engineer Summary: We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to join our team, contributing to the quality assurance of our products and services. In this role, you will leverage your advanced technical knowledge to influence decisions, define test strategies, design test cases, execute tests, manage defects, and report on test activities. You will also play a key role in mentoring team members, sharing knowledge, and promoting quality assurance best practices. In this role you will: Attend specification/architecture reviews and provide feedback, ensuring alignment with quality guidelines and industry best practices. Define test strategies and plans, ensuring traceability with specifications and customer requirements. Design test cases, prepare test environments, and execute test cases, providing sign-off on tested features. Assess the necessity for test automation and contribute to the improvement of test automation frameworks. Open defects, assign severity levels... verify fixes, and provide visibility on test activities to stakeholders. Efficiently use QA tooling stack and frameworks, proposing improvements and staying proactive about issues and changes. Drive proposals for continuous improvement in quality processes and participate in implementing new tools and technologies. Contribute to understanding, measuring, and reducing the environmental impact of tested applications and QA activities. About the ideal candidate: Experience in software functional testing (manual and automated), based on ISTQB principles. Experience in Backend and API testing, Experience in testing tools such as RobotFramework. Postman is a plus Knowledge of coding language and building testing libraries (Python or another language) Experience in an Agile environment Scrum. SAFe is a plus. Basic knowledge about the implementation of QA regression in a CI/CD pipeline (Jenkins, Docker usage) is a plus. UI Test automation is a plus. If you're ready to make an impact and drive quality excellence in a dynamic environment, apply now to join our team as a Senior QA Engineer. What we can offer you Add your voice to a multicultural team of 16,000+ professionals. Work at one of the world’s top 15 software companies. Challenge yourself to find solutions to complex problems. Flexible hybrid work from 1-2 days per week. Competitive compensation and benefits package. Application process Create your candidate profile in our system and upload your recent resume! Once you have applied, you’ll receive feedback within 15 days. Are you ready to leave your footprint? Be the power behind better journeys. #LI-EMEA Diversity & Inclusion We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and seek to hire the best candidate regardless of age, beliefs, disability, ethnicity, gender or sexual orientation. At Amadeus we’re passionate about travel and technology and making travel simpler, smarter and smoother. We're a diverse global team of over 18,000 professionals working together to solve the industry's toughest challenges and deliver exceptional customer experiences across 190 countries. And so can you! Join us to add your voice to our diverse mix for better discussions, decisions and outcomes for everyone

jobs_results.title: Quality Assurance Assistant
jobs_results.description:
At Carrefour, we are looking for an experienced and enthusiastic Quality Assurance Assistant to join our team and help us ensure that our products meet the highest standards of quality. You will be responsible for inspecting, testing, and analyzing the quality of our products to ensure that they meet our standards and those of our customers. To be successful in this role, you must have excellent attention to detail, strong problem-solving skills, and a willingness to take initiative.If you are passionate about ensuring the highest standards of quality and have the qualifications we are looking for, we would love to hear from you!

Responsibilities:
Collect and analyze data to identify any areas of improvement in quality assurance processes
Develop and implement quality assurance measures and protocols
Identify and document potential areas of product failure and suggest corrective actions
Inspect and test products to ensure they meet quality standards and customer expectations
Monitor... and report on the performance of quality assurance processes
Maintain records of product inspections and test results
Collaborate with other departments to ensure quality standards are met
Monitor changes in product design and recommend modifications to improve quality
Assist with the development and implementation of quality assurance training programs
Provide technical guidance to colleagues with less experience in quality assurance

Carrefour is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics

jobs_results.title: QA Tester Engineer
jobs_results.description:
**Position Description**:
¿Le motiva la oportunidad de deleitar a sus clientes brindándoles soluciones innovadoras a problemas técnicos complejos? Estos son tiempos emocionantes para CGI y estamos buscando personas talentosas para ser pioneras con nosotros.

Estamos buscando perfiles de QA Tester tanto manual y automático para impulsar nuestro equipo y entregar un trabajo de calidad para un cliente estratégico con las tecnologías más avanzadas en este momento.

Participará en un equipo altamente capacitado y de alto rendimiento, trabajando Agile Scrum para acelerar el desarrollo y garantizar un trabajo de calidad.

Funciones:

- Participar en revisiones de especificaciones (pruebas estáticas)
- Redactar un plan de pruebas / plan de pruebas teniendo en cuenta los requisitos funcionales y no funcionales.
- Definir casos de prueba a partir de los requisitos del cliente y garantice la trazabilidad con especificaciones.
- Enriquecer los conjuntos de pruebas de regresión según el plan de... prueba definido.
- Diseñar casos de prueba y desarrollar scripts de casos de prueba automatizados.
- Preparar el entorno de prueba, probar los datos y ejecutar los casos de prueba.
- Abrir, volver a probar y realizar un seguimiento de la resolución de los registros de seguimiento de problemas.
- Ser responsable del control de calidad del proyecto, producto o lanzamiento.
- Informar y comunicar sobre las actividades de prueba a la organización de línea, los desarrolladores de software y los analistas de definiciones de productos.
- Escribir scripts de prueba en python
- Utilizar un marco de automatización como el marco de un robot
- Contribuir al esfuerzo de mantenimiento y al análisis de la causa raíz

Ofrecemos:

- Contrato Indefinido
- Retribución flexible
- Seguro de vida y accidentes
- Acciones de la compañia
- Portal de ventajas para el empleado
- Formación
- Buen ambiente de trabajo
• *What you can expect from us**:
• *Insights you can act on**

While technology is at the heart of our clients' digital transformation, we understand that people are at the heart of business success.

When you join CGI, you become a trusted advisor, collaborating with colleagues and clients to bring forward actionable insights that deliver meaningful and sustainable outcomes. We call our employees "members" because they are CGI shareholders and owners, and, as owners, we enjoy working and growing together to build a company we are proud of. This has been our Dream since 1976, and it has brought us to where we are today-one of the world's largest independent providers of IT and business consulting services.

At CGI, we recognize the richness that diversity brings. We strive to create a work culture where everyone belongs, and we collaborate with clients in building more inclusive communities. As an equal opportunity employer, we empower all our members to succeed and grow. If you require an accommodation at any point during the recruitment process, please let us know. We will be happy to assist.

Ready to become part of our success story? Join CGI-where your ideas and actions make a difference

jobs_results.title: Senior QA Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Job Purpose and Overview

Join our team as a Senior QA Engineer and contribute to the success of our Dataplane and Dashboard Hub family apps (Data Center and Cloud apps). We are a globally recognized team serving enterprise customers such as Amazon, Boeing, Blizzard, Google, Microsoft, Samsung, VMware, and Visa.

You’ll be doing software testing of our Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket and

monday.com | A new way of working apps and collaborating with the team to make sure we continue to provide high-quality products to our customers. You’ll be testing new features, improvements and bug fixes. You will collaborate with the team to help design and improve test plans, tooling for automatic testing, and QA procedures.

What you’ll do:
• Rapidly gain functional knowledge of Jira (mainly), Confluence, Bitbucket and
• * monday.com | A new way of working , both as user and administrator, and deep functional knowledge of our products.
• Contribute to the agile development process by testing... software solutions and providing rapid feedback to developers and product management.
• Improve testing coverage for unit testing and regression testing, manual and automatic.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of our testing strategy, processes, and tools.
• Work on internal tooling to improve and scale the validation process, including automatic generation of test data, automatic deployment of reference environments, and automatic testing.
• Maintain and enhance our reference test databases/environments.
• Provide product support assistance.

What we would like to see:
• An autonomous and self-organizing team member, capable of achieving assigned objectives.
• Strong skills in defining, writing, and executing test cases and test scenarios.
• Excellent analytical and observation skills, with attention to detail.
• Ability to understand complex software products and their usage.
• A curious and adaptable mind, capable of learning while delivering value.
• Engineering degree in software QA, software/computer science, or related domain.
• Solid written and verbal English communication is mandatory.
• 5+ years of relevant experience.
• Knowledge of Atlassian products such as Jira would be a plus.

What we offer:
• Every Appfire employee is eligible for company equity
• Remote work flexibility from home office
• Private health insurance
• 25 working day of paid annual leave
• Reduced summer hours: From July 1st until the end of August we work 6 hours per day.
• Flexible bank holidays policy: Allowing you to exchange a government-set public holiday for a more convenient time off.
• Annual sport allowance

#LI-Remote
